tagline: Intreprinderea Optica Romana (IOR)取景器相机，1960 年发布
description: Intreprinderea Optica Romana (IOR)于1960年推出的取景器相机。配备Trioclar 1:3,2 f=50mm。快门速度T, 1/25, 1/50, 1/100。

specs.英文简介: The Orizont or Orizont 1, is a Romanian viewfinder camera produced around 1960 by Intreprinderea Optica Romana (IOR), the Romanian Optical Factory, probably copying the Altix V produced by Eho-Altissa, Dresden, Germany.
